title: Combining dead keys are not properly reported in the input system
body:
### Tested versions

Tested on v4.6.stable.arch_linux

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable unknown - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 24 Jan 2026 00:47:39 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT (RADV NAVI21) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.24 GiB memory

### Issue description

Dead keys are not correctly handled by Godot and get interpreted as NUL unicode characters. I.E. on the US International keyboard, first the appostrophe key is pressed, then e is pressed to produce é,  space to produce ', etc...

However, AltGr character, i.e å (AltGr + Z in KDE US International) are correctly understood by Godot

### Steps to reproduce

Add an _input event received, and try printing the current event, and unicode of said event. Instead of receiving Apostrophe then é unicode, godot will only receive Apostrophe with a unicode value of 0, then a regular e.

Here is the code and the resulting output in the console
```gd
func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventKey and event.is_pressed():
		print(event)
		print(event.unicode)
```
```
InputEventKey: keycode=39 (Apostrophe), mods=none, physical=false, location=unspecified, pressed=true, echo=false
0
InputEventKey: keycode=69 (E), mods=none, physical=false, location=unspecified, pressed=true, echo=false
101
```
